title: NCSM Notification 2026 - Walk-in interview for Trainee Craft Posts
description: The National Council of Science Museums (NCSM) has officially released the notification to fill the vacancy for 01 Trainee Craft Post. Interested and eligible candidates can use this opportunity to apply for these posts before the deadline. Candidates who have completed their 10th and ITI can apply for the NCSM Notification 2026 . Interested applicants can apply in offline mode. Here we have mentioned the education details, age limit, selection process, application fee, salary, and how to app...
